A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
OPLWH experience an HIV-NCD Syndemic and this has an effect on the way that healthcare is accessed and experienced.
the HIV-NCD syndemics experienced by older people living with HIV in our study are a result of structural barriers that are compounded by the fragmentation of care.

the HIV-NCD syndemics are a reality for OPLWH and that they are experiencing barriers to accessing healthcare that are not only physical, but structural as well.
the current system does not meet the needs of older persons living in poverty who are living with HIV and other chronic conditions.
